scope: Synthetic composition probes only; no runtime/device action.

results.name: campaign_ignores_explicit_bad_service_bindings
results.reason: evaluate_campaign calls validate_service_trace, not validate_service_binding; explicit identity/location/material/calibration errors are ignored.

results.name: campaign_does_not_validate_transfer
results.reason: Transport helper exists but campaign MOVE receipts need neither route/context nor safe-transfer validation.

results.name: campaign_has_no_raw_measurement_requirement
results.reason: Unmodified positive campaign fixture contains phase/operation/service receipt labels but no raw measurement records, hashes, units or measured-class checks.

results.name: campaign_ignores_reversed_operation_execution_order
results.reason: Membership alone permits inverse operation order; no occurrence-level event/phase mapping enforces operation ordering.
